Quick infra note on shapes and lead times:
- For the 120k tokens/hour 90% case we should assume an initial pool of 4xA100-80GB equiv (N1-style) with ability to scale to 8 within 2 weeks via burst capacity.
- Long lead constraint: if we need dedicated on-prem racks or specific GPU SKUs, procurement lead time is ~6 weeks. For public cloud reserved capacity we can provision faster but with different cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Risk buffer recommendation: +15% for unpredictable bursty inference (short lived spikes) + one-week cold-start buffer to account for model onboarding and quantization tuning.

I attached infra_capacity_notes.pdf with a quick runbook for onboarding a new dedicated pool. Will bring an initial cost estimate to Friday's sync.

Marcus
